text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin achieved magnificent results in 
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Big siiis, I'm all ready!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Here we go~! Ready, both of you...

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaah! Haaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, you're both so, so fast! Just what 
I'd expect from my little sisters!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Right, Trainer? Don't you think so too? 
Do you feel like scouting both of them 
now?"
choice_data_list:
I haven't fully matured physically yet, so 
it's hard to say right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Awakening is a growth period during 
which an Umamusume's racing abilities grow 
exponentially. Most Umamusume sign 
contracts with Trainers around this time—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer, you're as serious as 
always~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“Then again, it's probably only because 
he's such an uptight stick-in-the-mud that 
I was able to keep running.”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You worry way more than you need to, 
Trainer, don't you? Like when I collapsed 
after the Asahi Hai, you even tried to 
bring out a stretcher.
choice_data_list: Those days existed too, didn't they...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, because you went out of 
your way to be so considerate of others.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I believe that is how I was able to make 
it this far without any serious injuries. 
Period.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So when my little sisters come to Tracen 
Academy, I'd feel at ease knowing you'd be 
their Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We don't even know if either of them will 
enroll yet. Who knows, maybe by next year 
they'll both be chasing completely 
different dreams.
choice_data_list: We'll deal with it when the time comes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Big siiis! Next time you've gotta compete 
with us too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'll leave the starting official 
duties to you as usual!
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Can you hold back a little?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can do that! Running at 
full blast, that is!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Fuhe~... Big sis is so fast... Break 
time~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Time for me to take a break too... 
That 100m extra handicap really took a 
toll on me...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, the one over there is—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bright-chan, Dober-chan! And—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines! ...Wait, it's your little sisters! 
Long time no see!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Hello... It's Ryan-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, both of you have grown bigger again. 
Isn't the way your hindquarters are 
developing starting to resemble your big 
sister?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, are the three of you heading 
out together too, Ryan-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. To the racecourse museum. And after 
that, I was hoping to head to the gym and 
take a quick look at her form."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~, Ryan-chan. Acting like an 
instructor, huh~? Lookin' sharp, there 
there."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, Ines. You're giving me way too much 
credit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, though. Maybe not quite an 
instructor, but I've been thinking I'd 
like to be on the teaching side!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Time keeps marching relentlessly forward. 
There's no guarantee we can stay active 
competitors forever, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The time will come for everyone to leave 
the turf. So at the very least—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want my soul to become the energy that 
fuels those who follow after me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "...Ryan-chan really is cool after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but Ines, isn't that what you 
actually want to do for your own little 
sisters too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm... As for me—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I guess I don't really care.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I plan to pour all my love into it, but I 
won't surrender my soul."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm selfish, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I see. I guess that's another 
difference between you and me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bye, Ines. See you at the races!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Sorry about that, Suu-chan, 
Ruu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, even if those two join the racing 
world, I don't think I could ever be a 
good role model to them.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: You bet!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. 'Cause that's what big sisters do. 
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: You're gonna be my rival, right~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list:
You were going all out against your little 
sisters earlier, too.

You were going all out against your little 
sisters earlier, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. You're right, maybe we can become 
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, decided! Trainer, give me some 
special training tonight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it, right? I'm counting on you 
to keep making me the strongest, forever 
and ever!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Because you're—you're my Trainer!
